name: Milestone Payment Collection
query:
SELECT
  pmp.project as "Project:Link/Home Makeover Project:150",
  pmd.milestone_name as "Milestone:Data:150",
  pmd.due_date as "Due Date:Date:100",
  pmd.amount as "Amount:Currency:120",
  pmd.status as "Status:Data:100"
FROM `tabProject Milestone Detail` pmd
JOIN `tabProject Milestone Payment` pmp ON pmp.name = pmd.parent
ORDER BY pmd.due_date ASC
